regression: Single real H.264 frame must be emitted before successor or EOF; failed before, passes after
ownership: One borrowed normalized packet <=2 MiB; allocation-free NAL scan; six static delimiter bytes within the existing write deadline. Original decoder ownership/retirement unchanged.
limitations: Software FFmpeg fixtures only, not sensor/call latency. FFmpeg can log a metadata-only trailing access unit at EOF; no extra picture is emitted.
